title: Home Mortgage Loans Payoff and Lien Release Schedule: Statement Turnaround, Statement Fee and Recording Deadline
content:
The Payoff and Lien Release desk works every Home Mortgage Loans program to the same three figures: the business days within which a payoff statement is sent after a request, the fee carried for that statement, and the calendar days after payoff within which the satisfaction of the deed of trust is recorded.

| Program | Payoff statement sent within | Payoff statement fee | Satisfaction of the deed of trust recorded within |
|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 business days | $0.00 | 30 calendar days |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 business days | $0.00 | 30 calendar days |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 business days | $0.00 | 30 calendar days |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 business days | $0.00 | 30 calendar days |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 7 business days | $0.00 | 30 calendar days |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 business days | $0.00 | 30 calendar days |

## Notes to the schedule

The statement turnaround is counted in business days; the recording deadline is counted in calendar days. The two units are not interchangeable, and the schedule carries each figure in the unit stated against it.

Since the fee column reads $0.00 on all six programs, a payoff statement on any Home Mortgage Loans note is sent free of charge.
